VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Ladies and gentlemen, Reliance Jio going IPO!!!
On paper, JIO looks absolutely flawless. ₹1,46,885 crore in revenue. ₹30,049 crore in profit. And they have 524 million customers. So they practically serve 1/3rd of the entire Indian population!!
We all know the story of Jio, they made mobile data dramatically more affordable and they helped us turn India into an internet enabled country!! And that gave rise to everything from the creator economy to the acceleration of the Digital India revolution.
